description: Source code for the SortShuffleWriter class in Apache Spark, responsible for writing shuffle data during sort-based shuffles, including methods for writing records, stopping the writer, and managing checksums and partition lengths.

classes.name: SortShuffleWriter
classes.description: Handles writing shuffle data for sort-based shuffles, managing sorting, checksum calculation, and output file management.

methods.name: getRowBasedChecksums
methods.description: Returns the row-based checksums from the sorter if available, otherwise returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAggregatedChecksumValue
methods.description: Returns the aggregated checksum value from the sorter if available, otherwise returns 0.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a batch of records to the shuffle output, initializing the sorter and writing partitioned output.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the writer, optionally returning the MapStatus if successful, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getPartitionLengths
methods.description: Returns the lengths of each partition's data.
